title: Short-collection urinary albumin flux did not improve cross-cycle systolic-pressure prediction beyond flexible components
abstract: In separately sampled NHANES2013-14 (n=4399) and2015-16 (n=4203), a log urinary albumin flux spline was tested beyond flexible ACR, urinary creatinine, flow, serum creatinine and standard clinical covariates. Target weighted MSE changed from201.47144 to201.56566mmHg2: reduction -0.09422, approximate95% joint PSU-bootstrap interval[-1.42031,+0.63978]. Source PSU-grouped CV also worsened. Several registered sensitivities favored augmentation, excluding universal redundancy claims. This is a negative fixed-estimator representation test, not equivalence, causal evidence or clinical validation. Cross-cycle testing shares a survey platform and historically reused data. Author self-checks and offline reruns were performed; no independent peer review is claimed.
